Ritika Malhotra 91, a Senior Embedded Systems Engineer at HealthSense Devices, combines technical rigor with a pragmatic approach to solving complex healthtech challenges.  

Her firmware development work on the GlucoTrack 300 series cut calibration errors by 22% through sensor fusion algorithms, directly improving patient outcomes. She led hardware-software integration for the remote ECG monitor, resolving 14 critical timing conflicts in the bootloader that boosted system uptime to 99.8%. In RTOS optimization, she restructured the kernel’s task scheduling, reducing power consumption by 18% while maintaining real-time responsiveness.  

Ritika’s proficiency with C/C++ underpins her ability to debug low-level issues swiftly, and her Python scripts automate 70% of routine testing, freeing teams for higher-impact work. She also designed REST APIs for device telemetry, cutting data latency by 30% through protocol optimization.  

Ritika’s work ethic is unshakable—she routinely volunteers to mentor junior engineers and stays late to resolve production issues. Her blend of analytical precision and collaborative spirit makes her a reliable, high-impact contributor.
